source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 4 June 1949, p. 3 ("County and rural council results"); Irish News, 4 June 1949, p. 3 ("Rural council election results"); Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1949, p. 7 ("Nominations for county and rural councils"); Derry Journal, 6 June 1949, p. 6 ("Limavady Rural Council results")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Results BNL 4 Jun 1949 p3 (Limavady paragraph, all four with figures); electorate and total poll from the Derry Journal results table, 6 Jun 1949 p6 ('There were no spoiled votes in any division'). Labels as in the BNL nominations, 18 May 1949 p7.

note: Triennial election of the 23 electoral divisions of Limavady rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Six contests were nominated, but withdrawals reduced these to four. The Unionists regained control, taking Drumraighland on a drawn lot after a tie. Sixteen of the nineteen unopposed members added from the nominations reports (Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1949, p. 6; Derry Journal, 20 May 1949), which name them without divisions: Foreglen and Scriggan from the withdrawals the reports describe, the other fourteen from their divisions at the 1946 return. Aghanloo, Feeny and The Highlands are held: their members (W. J. Thompson, James O'Kane and John Alcorn) are not in the 1946 return, and only later sources place them (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026).
